in_sanskrit.name: जयकुमार
in_sanskrit.meaning: Victorious in War, Victorious in Battle
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: जय: victory, कु: in, मार: death, विक्तौ: past tense of कौ, र: having. So, Jaykumar means 'having victory over death in battle'.

in_hindi.name: जयकुमार
in_hindi.long_meaning: जय: victory, कु: in, मार: death, राज: ruler. So, Jaykumar means 'ruler over death on the battlefield'.

in_tamil.name: ஜயகுமார்
in_tamil.long_meaning: விக்கோ: victory, கு: in, மார்: death, விடுதலையார்: one who has victory over death.

in_telugu.name: జెయ్యకూమార్
in_telugu.long_meaning: జై: victory, హో: in, మేశ్: lord, శ్వర: supreme. So, Jaykumar means 'Lord of supreme victory' in Telugu.

in_marathi.name: Jaykumar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Victory over God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jaykumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jaya (Victory) + Kumar (God's son)

in_bengali.name: Jaykumar
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Victory over God
in_bengali.long_meaning: Jaykumar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Jaya (Victory) + Kumar (God's son)
